max_tire.note: The practical limit. Even 33s meant moving the front fender liner forward about 1 in.

One IH8MUD build: liner moved about 1.75 in, sidestep return trimmed, body mount reshaped. The builder recommends an effective offset of +30 to +35 mm. It's easier than on a Land Cruiser because the LX has no KDSS bar.

items.title: Seat-belt tension sensor harness
items.summary: The harness can break and switch off the front passenger, knee and seat-mounted side airbags. Dealers modify or replace the belt assembly.

items.title: Incorrect airbag fitted
items.summary: Some trucks may have the wrong driver or passenger airbag. Dealers replace the affected assemblies.

items.title: Accelerator pedal entrapment by floor mat
items.summary: The pedal can stick wide open if trapped by an unsecured or incompatible mat. Dealers modify or replace the pedal and the mats.

items.title: Low-pressure fuel pump
items.summary: The fuel pump may fail and stall the engine. Dealers replace it.

items.title: Low-pressure fuel pump (expansion)
items.summary: Same pump failure on later trucks. Dealers fit an improved assembly.

timeline.change: Debuts in April 2007 at the New York show. 3UR-FE 5.7 V8 (383 hp), AB60F six-speed, Torsen center diff, double-wishbone front, six-height AHC, Crawl Control and a frame-integrated hitch rated to 8,500 lb.
Most of the radiator-crack reports come from these years, and owners say 2008s had water-pump issues.
Mild facelift with a new front bumper. First year of the heated steering wheel.
No US model year. 2011 production ran late and 2013 started early.
First spindle-grille facelift. Five-speed Crawl Control, Multi-Terrain Select and Turn Assist.
Major refresh (only the doors and roof carry over). AE80F eight-speed, all-new interior, all-speed radar cruise and optional 21-in wheels.
Final year, with a second 500-unit Inspiration Series. Production ends in October 2021.

identify.intro: The LX 570 shares everything that matters with the 200 Series Land Cruiser, so check the facelift, the drivetrain generation and whether it's one of the limited Inspiration trucks.

items.head: VIN
items.body: US trucks start JTJ and carry 7AX in positions 6–8 (e.g. JTJHY7AX). NHTSA's vPIC decoder reads the series as URJ201L with the 3UR-FE, built at Toyota Auto Body's Yoshiwara plant. The 10th character is the model year (8 = 2008 through M = 2021, with no C for 2012).

items.head: Which facelift
items.body: 2008–2011: original nose. 2013–2015: first spindle grille. 2016–2021: big spindle, new sheet metal, eight-speed and a new interior.

items.head: Seating
items.body: Two-row, five-seat trucks exist only from 2018 on.

items.head: Inspiration Series
items.body: 2019: 500 trucks in Black Onyx with a Moonlight white interior and blacked-out trim. 2021: 500 trucks in Eminent White Pearl or Black Onyx with black-and-Rioja-red leather.

items.head: No axle lockers
items.body: US trucks have a lockable Torsen center diff, A-TRAC and Crawl Control, but no factory front or rear lockers. Any locker is aftermarket.

capability.note: frame-integrated hitch; the 2016-on owner's manual lists 7,000 lb (3,175 kg) with trailer brakes
roof luggage carrier limit, owner's manual

capability.v: AHC: about +3 in / −2 in from normal

values.intro: Prices split by facelift. Early trucks are bargain Land Cruisers, and low-mile 2016–2021 trucks still trade near their original sticker.
values.note: Based on 17 Bring a Trailer LX 570 sales from May to October 2026, from $15,250 (2010) to $98,500 (a 5,000-mile 2019 Inspiration Series). Several 2013–2017 trucks were bid to $17k–49k without selling.
